rows.what: Managed-auth **development** instance + keys
Auth settings: the tenancy (multi, or single with its tenant) and the org source (the provider's, or one fixed home org and role)
Managed-auth **production** instance (typically one per tenant site)
Email domain + API key (names in `apps/<app>/config/params.ts`)
Inbound route(s) + the inbound webhook signing key
Model-provider API key
Error-tracking project + DSN (set your own org in `apps/<app>/config/params.ts`)
Analytics/flags project + key and host
The role the app connects as (the one in `DATABASE_URL` on `pg`, the one the secret at `DATABASE_SECRET_ARN` holds on `data-api`) holds neither `SUPERUSER` nor `BYPASSRLS`

On `pg`, the server and the Migrator reach the database over TLS that verifies its certificate: `DATABASE_SSL_MODE` (`verify-full` when unset; `disable` only for a server with no TLS) and `DATABASE_SSL_ROOT_CERT` (the roots to trust)
The Lambda origin answers only CloudFront
The database credential is fetched at runtime, not baked into function config

The opt-in RDS Data API transport (`params.database.transport: 'data-api'`, so `DATABASE_TRANSPORT=data-api`): the Data API enabled on the cluster, and the cluster ARN, secret ARN and database name in the environment
The Data API network shape deployed (`params.database.transport: 'data-api'`): the Data API enabled on the cluster, both Lambdas outside the VPC, IAM the only path to the database
Cloud account IDs, region, profiles
The storage port's `list`/`delete` against the real bucket
The storage port's `copy` against the real bucket
The storage port's `head`, and `copy`'s `ifMatch`, against the real bucket
An S3-compatible store's bucket, endpoint, region and upload-target setting (`params.ports.storage: 's3-compatible'`, so `STORAGE_PROVIDER=s3-compatible`: Cloudflare R2, MinIO, Backblaze B2)
The access key pair for an S3-compatible store (`STORAGE_ACCESS_KEY_ID`, `STORAGE_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY`), in the deployment's secret store and never in the repository
The storage port's methods against a real bucket on the S3-compatible store the app chose (for R2: a real R2 bucket)
Async job compute + the shared webhook secret
A scheduler POSTing `/api/webhooks/cron` (the app's route, over SSSB's `runScheduledTick`) on a fixed cadence with the same shared secret
Registering a real counterparty's public key (key-management UI deliberately deferred)
DNS zones + TLS certs
CI/CD: PR preview environments, staging on merge
SSSB's own repository only: the GitHub App whose token lets `release.yml` push the release commit to `main` and its `vX.Y.Z` tag. Made by `pnpm release-app:init` (`docs/runbooks/release-app.md`)
Approval for the managed database, CDN, and friends
Public URL for the `DEMO_MODE` build
